It is part of the [[City Football Group]]. Founded for the first time on 1 November 1900 as Anglo Palermitan Athletic and Football Club, Palermo is one of the oldest clubs in Italy. Among the club's accomplishments are a [[Coppa Italia Serie C]], won in the 1992–93, and five Serie B league titles. It also appeared in three [[Coppa Italia]] finals: in [[1973–74 Coppa Italia|1973–74]], in [[1978–79 Coppa Italia|1978–79]] and in [[2010–11 Coppa Italia|2010–11]]. It has played 29 seasons in [[Serie A]]. Internationally, the club has made five appearances in European competitions, all in the [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup/Europa League]]."}}
